# [TASK] Implement Media Service (MinIO + MongoDB)

## Task

Build media-service's core CRUD API for user-uploaded media, backed by MongoDB metadata and MinIO object storage (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.8, port 8085). This service never stores TMDB poster/backdrop bytes — only future user uploads. The client keeps resolving TMDB images directly from image.tmdb.org.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] MediaFile/MediaMetadata MongoDB document models exist, matching ARCHITECTURE.md §3.8's schema
- [x] Upload, get-by-id, delete, and list-by-entity endpoints work end-to-end against MinIO + MongoDB
- [x] Thumbnail generation on upload
- [x] Eureka registration, actuator health endpoint, Dockerfile
- [x] Test suite (Testcontainers / Mockito tests per repo convention) passes

## Estimate

**Hours:** 12

## Notes

- Completed: added domain records (`EntityType`, `MediaType`, `MediaMetadata`, `MediaFile`), repository, `StorageService` (MinIO wrapper with thumbnail generator), `MediaService`, `MediaController` OpenAPI endpoints, multi-stage Dockerfile, and comprehensive JUnit 5 / Mockito unit tests.
- Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §3.8.
